head_commit.message:
Preserve early unified exec output in completion events (#47665)

## Why

Output produced before the streaming subscriber attaches can be missing from command completion events, even when it was returned to the model.

## What changed

Record the bounded completion transcript directly in `UnifiedExecProcess` as local and exec-server output arrives. Keep it independent of output polling and streaming delta delivery, and use it for completion events.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for output collected before subscription, both with and without later output. Strengthen the lifecycle test to assert that `aggregated_output` includes both early and late output.

head_commit.message:
Preserve managed network policy in route-aware transports (#47663)

## Why

The default transport fallback bypassed managed application network policy when using `ReqwestDefault` proxy handling or running inside the Codex sandbox.

## What changed

Use a `RouteAwareClientPool` whenever application network policy is managed, retaining policy enforcement for requests and redirects while preserving legacy proxy behavior and custom CA fallback.

## Testing

Add code mode web search regression cases for denied initial requests and denied redirect destinations, verifying that policy errors reach tool output and no requests reach the denied destination.

head_commit.message:
Expose tool dispatch and timing observations to extensions (#47662)

## Why

Tool lifecycle observers need visibility into calls rejected before execution starts and timing that remains available on cancellation, independently of tracing settings.

## What changed

- Add `on_tool_dispatch` and `on_tool_timing` callbacks to `ToolLifecycleContributor`, with thread, turn, and call IDs for correlation.
- Report direct calls before readiness, dispatch waiting, and hooks. Report handler duration when dispatch completes or is dropped, excluding readiness and gate waiting and returning zero if the call never passes the gate.
- Expose code-mode host durations as a separate `HostOperation` timing boundary. Exclude nested code-mode calls from dispatch and handler timing observations to avoid double counting.

## Testing

Add tests for callback ordering on completed and rejected calls, timing on cancellation, zero handler duration before gate admission without tracing, and code-mode host timing without nested dispatch or handler timing observations.

GitOrigin-RevId: 97998b5094564c13cb2cfad089bb0a9d6615eb5c

head_commit.message:
Make Linux descriptor cleanup fork-safe (#47654)

## Why

Linux descriptor cleanup used allocating directory enumeration after `fork`. The child needs allocation-free cleanup while preserving Rust's spawn-error channel until `exec` succeeds.

## What changed

- Mark unrelated descriptors close-on-exec with `close_range(CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC)`, leaving stdio and explicitly preserved descriptors' flags untouched.
- Fall back to stack-backed `getdents64` enumeration of the child's descriptor table when `close_range` fails.
- Document best-effort cleanup: failures allow launch to proceed and may leave unrelated descriptors inherited.

## Testing

Add Linux tests for descriptor inheritance, unsorted and duplicate allowlists, unchanged parent descriptors, fallback cleanup above a lowered descriptor limit, preserved exec-error reporting, and successful launch when both cleanup paths fail. Retain MCP coverage for descriptor exclusion in servers and descendants.

GitOrigin-RevId: 13abb95f82557324c7b40feb36bd6f806d60674e

head_commit.message:
Attach inherited rollout history to diagnostic reports (#47653)

## Why

Selected rollouts can reference history stored in ancestor rollouts through `history_base`. Attaching only the selected files leaves that inherited history out of diagnostic reports.

## What changed

When `include_logs` is enabled, follow nested `history_base` references and attach ancestor prefixes up to the recorded byte offsets. Deduplicate ancestors, retain the largest requested prefix, and skip rollouts already selected for upload.

Bound discovery to 64 ancestors and five seconds, and enforce attachment size limits. Missing, unreadable, or incomplete ancestor prefixes are best effort and do not prevent the report upload.

## Testing

Add a unit test verifying that nested parent and grandparent history bases are attached with the expected filenames and contents.

GitOrigin-RevId: d9bba3e50573d25843d2eaedeae775946223ed0e

Add opt-in OTLP logging for final agent responses (#47649)

## What changed

Add `otel.log_agent_responses`, disabled by default and requiring an OTLP HTTP or gRPC log exporter. Emit `codex.agent_response` for completed `final_answer` messages from main agents and spawned task agents, with session, turn, item, and available parent/root attribution.

Strip memory citations from exported text, preserve the stored answer, and cap responses at 64 KiB on a UTF-8 character boundary. Include the original byte length and a truncation flag, and suppress duplicate item completions within each turn. Exclude commentary and non-task agents.

## Testing

Extend configuration tests for default-off and explicit opt-in behavior, the agent execution test for main/subagent response attribution, and the log-buffer test for response-event exclusion.
